agendas.name: Blood for the Blood God!
agendas.description: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit destroys an enemy unit in melee, it gains 1XP (max 3XP per battle). Note any units that Fall Back; post-game each unit that Fell Back must take an Out of Action test.

agendas.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne!
agendas.description: Each time a WORLD EATERS unit destroys an enemy Character or Monster in melee, it gains 2XP (4XP if the enemy Warlord). Max 5XP per unit. If any unit gained 4+ XP, gain +1 Skull point.

agendas.name: Anoint the Field
agendas.description: Each time an enemy unit wholly within a table quarter is destroyed, anoint that quarter (twice = drowned). Post-game: 3 drowned quarters = each non-destroyed WORLD EATERS unit gains 2XP; 4 drowned = 3XP each + +1 to your Judgement roll.

agendas.name: A Tribute to Murder
agendas.description: Before shooting, task a WORLD EATERS unit to exalt a controlled, unexalted Veneration Site (no shoot/charge). On success: 2XP. If 3+ sites are exalted post-game, one World Eaters Requisition costs 0RP.
